brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.

requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster (0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0) with cover on 1,0,0 and centered handle handle:1,0,0;top (Trinity handle inserts) providing top carry grip

requirements.requirement: divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) providing divided storage for screws/bits

finish.summary: Built compact L-shaped 3-cell caddy with handle cell (1,0,0) carrying the load and two adjacent cells fitted with divided bins (2-compartment and 3-compartment) for screws and bits. Joint bolts lock structure, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
